what_it_is.prose: BEML is a Schedule 'A' CPSE under India's Ministry of Defence, manufacturing heavy equipment for Defence & Aerospace, Rail & Metro, Mining & Construction. Defence products include BEML-Tatra 8x8 High Mobility Vehicles (HMVs) for the Indian Army's Pinaka MBRL, BrahMos missile launcher and Smerch systems; bridge-layer tanks; Armoured Recovery & Repair Vehicle (ARRV) for the Arjun MBT; 1500-hp 'Bharat Power Pack' / DATRAN 1500 engine for Arjun (in development with CVRDE/DRDO, 90% indigenous content); Field Artillery Tractor; Medium & Heavy Recovery Vehicle. BEML won a ₹293.81 Cr MoD contract for 150 High Mobility Vehicles in Jul 2025. The company also supplies ground support vehicles for the Integrated Guided Missile / Radar Development Projects.

rows.india_status: Backbone of Indian Army's Pinaka MBRL, BrahMos missile launcher and Smerch rocket launcher mobility platforms; variants include Bridge Layer, Field Artillery Tractor, Medium & Heavy Recovery Vehicle. ₹293.81 Cr contract for 150 HMVs awarded Jul 2025
BEML produces the ARRV based on the Arjun MBT chassis for the Indian Army's armoured regiments; recovers disabled combat tanks
1500-hp engine developed by CVRDE/DRDO with BEML as production partner; 90% indigenous content; 20 engines contracted for Arjun MBT trials. Trials completed Jul 2025
